Spells

Sacred Flame

ID: spell:protection:1 Page: 1 Action: Main Action SP: 0 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: One creature within 12 squares Duration: Instant

Call a descending spark of sacred light. Deal 2/3/5 radiant damage.

Shield

ID: spell:protection:2 Page: 2 Action: Reaction · before the roll for an attack your magical shield can block SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: Until the start of your next turn

Raise a translucent shield in a free hand. Declare this Reaction before the roll for an attack the shield could block; the DA judges its coverage as for an ordinary shield. While keeping that hand available until your next turn starts, gain 1 Boon on defenses against attacks it can block. If an attacker rolls instead, apply 1 Bane to that roll. Shield and Shield Block supply the same shield benefit: use it once, while combining Defend and other modifiers normally. Ending the spell frees the hand. This Reaction casting does not provoke an opportunity attack.

Mage Armor

ID: spell:protection:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: 8 hours

Clothe yourself in a protective magical outline. Gain physical resistance 1, using the highest matching resistance. The armor persists for eight hours without Sustain.

Bladeturn

ID: spell:protection:4 Page: 4 Action: Reaction · after your defense against an adjacent melee attack SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: The triggering attack

Turn the edge aside. Reduce its physical damage by 2 after resistance, keeping the attack's minimum 1 damage.

Protection from Evil and Good

ID: spell:protection:5 Page: 5 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 10 minutes

Ward the recipient against summoned forms, undead and spirits. It gains 1 Boon to defenses against attacks and hostile spells from those creatures.

Protection from Energy

ID: spell:protection:6 Page: 6 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 2 to that type for the duration, using the highest matching resistance.

Death Ward

ID: spell:protection:7 Page: 7 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 1 hour or until triggered

The first time damage would reduce the recipient from positive HP to 0, leave it at 1 HP and end the ward. A creature can benefit from Death Ward once between safe overnight rests. Record that use when it triggers.

Warding Bond

ID: spell:protection:8 Page: 8 Action: Main Action SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares; remain within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Bind your protection to the recipient. When an attack would damage it, you may spend your Reaction after its resistance and other reductions, before it loses HP. Transfer up to 3 of that damage to yourself, leaving at least 1 on it. The transferred damage bypasses your resistance. The bond ends if either participant becomes unconscious or moves beyond 6 squares.

Globe of Invulnerability

ID: spell:protection:a1 Page: A1 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: Self and willing creatures within 2 squares of you Duration: 1 minute

Raise a shimmering globe centered on you. Protected creatures gain 1 Boon to defenses against spells and resistance 2 to spell damage. Apply the highest matching resistance. The protection moves with you.

Mind Blank

ID: spell:protection:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing adjacent creature Duration: 8 hours

Veil its thoughts. Grant mental resistance 3 and 2 Boons to defenses against mental spells. Reading its memories or locating it through divination requires its consent while the veil lasts. Ordinary observation and conversation remain available.

Prismatic Wall

ID: spell:protection:a3 Page: A3 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: Six connected unoccupied squares within 12 squares Duration: 1 minute

Raise a luminous wall 2 squares high that blocks sight. Roll on casting to set radiant damage at 4/6/8. A creature crossing it takes that damage and Slowed 2, once per creature each round. The caster can end the wall with a Maneuver.

Spells

Resistance

ID: spell:sanctuary:1 Page: 1 Action: Maneuver SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: Until your next turn ends

Choose fire, cold, lightning or poison. Grant resistance 1 to that type, using the highest matching resistance.

Sanctuary

ID: spell:sanctuary:2 Page: 2 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Give the recipient 1 Boon to defenses while it attends to healing, movement or other peaceful actions. Its first attack or harmful spell ends the ward after that action resolves.

Quiet Ways

ID: spell:sanctuary:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Self and up to three willing creatures within 6 squares Duration: 10 minutes

Soften footfalls and rustling gear. Recipients gain 1 Boon to sneaking that depends on quiet movement. Speech and deliberate noise remain audible.

Tiny Hut

ID: spell:sanctuary:4 Page: 4 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: A fixed 2-square-radius dome on clear ground beside you Duration: 8 hours

Create a weatherproof shelter for six Medium creatures and their ordinary gear. It has an openable entrance and translucent walls. Ordinary rain, snow and wind stay outside; occupants can leave and return. The shelter provides cover but no resistance to attacks. Choose a safe site for overnight recovery.

Private Sanctum

ID: spell:sanctuary:5 Page: 5 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One fixed room up to 6 by 6 squares beside you Duration: 8 hours

Seal ordinary sound inside the room and make its windows opaque from outside. Remote magical sensors report only a blank space unless their caster completes a cancellation objective against this working. Doors remain usable by ordinary means.

Hallow

ID: spell:sanctuary:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: A fixed 4-square-radius site beside you; 50 coins of incense consumed Duration: 24 hours

Consecrate the site. Willing occupants gain 1 Boon to defenses against undead and spirits while inside. Ordinary remains there resist decay for the duration. Choose the site's visible symbol when casting.

Guards and Wards

ID: spell:sanctuary:7 Page: 7 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: A building of up to six connected rooms beside you Duration: 8 hours

Ward the rooms with soft warning bells. Name up to six guests. When another creature opens an exterior door or window, you hear its location while within 100 squares. It receives Slowed 1 on first entry, once per creature. Doors remain physically operable and warnings persist even after that slowing ends.

Antilife Shell

ID: spell:sanctuary:8 Page: 8 Action: Main Action SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: A 1-square-radius ring centered on you Duration: 1 minute

A barrier of repelling force surrounds you. A living creature crossing its boundary spends 2 extra movement and becomes Slowed 1, once per round. The ring moves with you; moving it over a creature applies the same effect rather than pushing it automatically.

Forbiddance

ID: spell:sanctuary:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: A fixed 6-by-6-square site beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed Duration: 24 hours

Seal the site against teleportation and planar passage. A travel spell entering or leaving arrives at the nearest safe boundary square instead. Ordinary movement remains available. A successful cancellation objective ends the seal.

Magnificent Mansion

ID: spell:sanctuary:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One doorway on an adjacent solid surface Duration: 8 hours

Open a comfortable refuge with six furnished rooms, clean water and bedding for twelve. The entrance remains fixed and visible; you may open or close it with a Maneuver while beside it. At expiry occupants and their possessions emerge into safe space beside the original entrance. Furnishings remain part of the refuge. Food is brought by the guests.

Mighty Fortress

ID: spell-mastery:guards-and-wards-living-citadel Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 3 days, 8 hours each day SP: 10 Attribute: None Target / range: One prepared 12-by-12-square site; soil, water, stone and 600 coins of materials consumed Duration: Permanent structure; wards renewed for 24 hours

On a sound prepared site, raise a one-story living keep with six rooms, a courtyard, a gate and walls 3 squares high. Pay 10 SP on each workday. Walls block movement and sight; each 1-square section has 20 HP and physical resistance 3, and takes at least 1 damage per attack. Designate up to twelve residents. Paying 4 SP at dawn renews the wards for 24 hours: residents inside gain 1 Boon to defenses, and you sense any breached wall’s location while inside. Without renewal the ordinary structure remains. It needs food, water and repairs. You may ward one citadel at a time.

Mage Seal

Place a visible personal mark across its opening. Opening the container visibly breaks the mark. You recognize your own seal and whether it was broken when you next inspect it.

Alarm

ID: spell:seals:2 Page: 2 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One doorway or 2-square-radius area beside you Duration: 8 hours

Name up to six guests. When another creature crosses the boundary, a chime sounds within 6 squares or you receive a mental warning while within 100 squares; choose when casting. The first warning ends the spell.

Arcane Lock

ID: spell:seals:3 Page: 3 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent closed door or container Duration: 8 hours

Add magical fastening. An ordinary opening objective increases by 3 progress. Name up to six creatures who may operate it normally. Knock ends the magical fastening automatically. Completing a cancellation objective also ends it. Physical locks remain in place.

Knock

ID: spell:seals:4 Page: 4 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One lock or fastening within 6 squares Duration: Instant

A sharp knock carries 12 squares. Choose one fastening. Against Arcane Lock, end its magical fastening automatically and leave any physical lock in place. Against an ordinary fastening, roll to add 2/3/4 progress toward opening it.

Magic Mouth — Warning

ID: spell:seals:5 Page: 5 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One fixed object within reach Duration: 24 hours or until triggered

Record a warning of up to twenty-five words and a visible or audible trigger within 6 squares. The first matching event speaks the warning loudly enough to hear within 12 squares, then ends the spell.

Glyph of Warding

ID: spell:seals:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: One fixed surface within reach; burst within 1 square of it Duration: 8 hours or until triggered

Inscribe a visible glyph and define a creature crossing or touching its surface as the trigger. On the first trigger, every creature in the burst takes 3/5/7 force damage, set by your ritual roll. The glyph triggers once. Moving its surface more than 1 square ends it safely.

Rune Mastery — Seal

ID: spell:seals:7 Page: 7 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One fixed seal and one known Main Action spell costing at most 2 SP Duration: 8 hours or until triggered

Pay the stored spell's SP in addition to the ritual. Choose its targets relative to the seal and a visible or audible trigger within 3 squares. At the first trigger, release it using your class’s casting attribute and legal targets, then end the seal. Keep one such prepared seal at a time.

Secret Chest

ID: spell:seals:8 Page: 8 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent chest holding up to 12 Bulk; 25 coins of incense consumed Duration: 24 hours

Hide the chest and its contents in a private folded space. While beside its original location, use a Main Action to return it there. At expiry it returns automatically to the nearest open space. Living creatures remain outside; keep one Secret Chest at a time.

Symbol

ID: spell:seals:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Reason Target / range: One fixed visible inscription; targets within 2 squares Duration: 8 hours or until triggered

Choose a visible trigger and either dread or bewilderment. On its first occurrence, up to three creatures you specify by position gain Frightened 2/3/4 or Dazed 1/1/2, set by your ritual roll. Dread names the inscription as source. The inscription then fades.

Sequester

ID: spell:seals:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature or unattended object beside you; 100 coins of incense consumed Duration: 7 days

Place it in a concealed, motionless magical sleep or stasis. It becomes Invisible and its bodily needs pause. Touching it with the token you designate, Remove Curse, or expiry awakens and reveals it. Record its HP and SP on entry; those values return unchanged.

Gate — World Anchor

ID: spell-mastery:gate-world-anchor Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 7 days, 8 hours each day SP: 10 Attribute: None Target / range: Two known prepared stone anchors and 1,000 coins of materials consumed Duration: Permanent, until an anchor is destroyed or the pair is replaced

Prepare both sites with their owners’ permission and pay 10 SP on each workday. Join the anchors with a permanent paired gateway, 2 squares wide, even across planes. Create two keys. At either anchor, a keyholder may spend a Main Action and 3 of their own SP to open both ends for 10 minutes, or a Maneuver to close them. Anyone can cross an open gateway. Each anchor has 30 HP and physical resistance 3 and takes at least 1 damage per attack. Destroying either ends the connection. Keep one pair; completing another ends the first.

Pay the chosen spell's SP in addition to this ritual. Name a visible or bodily trigger and legal self-directed effect. When triggered while conscious, spend your Reaction to release that spell on yourself. You may keep one Contingency; casting another replaces the earlier preparation.

Armor IV

ID: spell:imbuement:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 8 hours SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One suit of armor beside you; 100 coins of enchanting oil consumed Duration: 7 days

Choose fire, cold, lightning, poison, life, radiant, mental or force. While worn with its normal training, the suit grants resistance 2 to that damage type. Use the highest matching resistance. You may keep one Armor IV enchantment at a time.

Imbue Spell

ID: spell:imbuement:imbue-spell Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 8 hours SP: 8 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended mundane handheld item; 200 coins of enchanting materials consumed Duration: Until dismissed, unraveled or replaced

Bind one known Main Action or Maneuver spell costing 1–5 SP into the item. Its bearer may release that spell once between your safe overnight rests, using the spell’s stated action and attribute, with the bearer’s attribute value and position. The release costs 0 SP; all other casting requirements, materials and costs apply. The bearer handles any Sustain or commands. Choose a spell from outside Channeling that neither restores or transfers SP nor enchants another item. You keep one imbued item. Completing another ends the previous enchantment without renewing its used release; all your replacements share that allowance. Your normal safe overnight rest renews the allowance once per 24 hours.

Discipline: Force List: Shaping ID: shaping Endpoint: Masterwork Forms

Reshape and repair existing nonliving material.

Spells

Mending

ID: spell:shaping:1 Page: 1 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended mundane item of Bulk 1 or less in your hands Duration: Instant

Rejoin a small clean break or tear while holding all its pieces together. Restore ordinary function to that part. For an item with HP, the DA states before casting whether this small repair is sufficient and how many HP it restores, following the repair-objective rules. Missing components and substantial reconstruction use repair projects.

Grease

ID: spell:shaping:2 Page: 2 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Four connected ground squares within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Coat the ground in slippery magical grease. It becomes difficult terrain. A creature entering from outside may move carefully for 2 additional movement, or become Prone after moving into its first greasy square. Choose when entering.

Enlarge/Reduce — Objects

ID: spell:shaping:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 2 or less within 6 squares Duration: 10 minutes

Double or halve its dimensions and Bulk, rounding Bulk up with a minimum of 1. Its material and function remain ordinary. It returns to original size at expiry; allow enough space for either size when casting.

Unlocking Ways

ID: spell:shaping:4 Page: 4 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent mundane lock Duration: Instant

Guide its mechanism with invisible tools. Add 1/2/3 progress toward the lock's DA-set opening objective. The spell supplies delicate manipulation; an explicit magical seal uses its named remedy.

Heat Metal — Forge

ID: spell:shaping:5 Page: 5 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended metal workpiece of Bulk 3 or less within reach Duration: 10 minutes

Heat it evenly to forging temperature or cool it to a safe working temperature. Use suitable tools to shape it with ordinary Craft procedures. The workpiece cools naturally when the duration ends.

Stone Shape — Craft

ID: spell:shaping:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent unattended stone mass up to one square in each dimension Duration: Instant

Shape a simple brace, slab, stair or other solid construction component, preserving its volume. Fine mechanisms and final fitting use ordinary tools. Living stone creatures follow creature-targeting spells.

Fabricate

ID: spell:shaping:7 Page: 7 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 3 Attribute: Class Target / range: Prepared ordinary materials and tools beside you Duration: Instant

Work the materials toward one mundane item or component of Bulk 6 or less whose construction you understand. Each completed ritual adds 3/5/7 progress toward its ordinary crafting objective, using the normal recipe and material quantities. The item is ready when that objective is complete. Finish fine details with the required tools.

Earthen Transmutations

ID: spell:shaping:8 Page: 8 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent unattended square of earth or stone, up to 1 square deep Duration: Instant

Turn loose earth into ordinary stone or ordinary stone into compacted earth. Preserve the material's volume. The DA identifies unsupported structures before casting; changing their support uses the normal collapse procedure.

Passwall — Workshop

ID: spell:shaping:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent ordinary wall up to 2 squares thick Duration: 1 hour

Make a work opening 1 square wide and 2 high through stone or earth. At expiry the opening closes; occupants emerge at the nearest end first. Secure ordinary supports before using it in a load-bearing wall.

Meld Wall

ID: spell:shaping:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: Two adjacent ordinary stone surfaces, each up to 4 squares in area Duration: Instant

Join them into one sound wall or floor, or separate them along one clean seam. Supply adequate support and matching stone. The resulting structure has the strength and vulnerabilities of ordinary masonry.

True Polymorph — Objects

ID: spell:shaping:a3 Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 6 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 12 or less; 100 coins of reagents consumed Duration: Until dismissed or replaced

Reshape it into one mundane object of equal or smaller Bulk made of stone, wood, glass or common iron. Choose an ordinary function whose construction you understand, with all necessary parts. It has that material’s ordinary qualities and provides no precious substances or learned abilities. Keep one such transformation at a time; dismissing it, completing another, or unraveling it returns the surviving material to its original form. Separated pieces remain parts of the same transformation, not new objects to copy.

Move objects through directed force.

Spells

Arcane Bolt

ID: spell:telekinesis:1 Page: 1 Action: Main Action SP: 0 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: One creature within 12 squares Duration: Instant

Strike with a bolt of compressed force. Deal 2/3/5 force damage.

Mage Hand

ID: spell:telekinesis:2 Page: 2 Action: Maneuver SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended object of Bulk 1 or less within 6 squares Duration: Until your next turn ends

A spectral hand lifts and moves the object up to 2 squares, or opens one unlocked door or container. It handles ordinary items with simple motions. Each new manipulation uses another casting.

Magic Missile

ID: spell:telekinesis:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: Up to three creatures within 12 squares Duration: Instant

Send luminous darts along clear paths. Roll once for a shared total of 3/5/7 force damage; divide it before resistance, assigning at least 1 to each target. Each target takes one damage event.

Staying

ID: spell:telekinesis:4 Page: 4 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: Class Defense: Brawn Target / range: One creature within 6 squares Hold attribute: Knowledge Escape attribute: Brawn Duration: Sustained, up to 1 minute

Invisible pressure pins the target’s movement. Apply Slowed 1/2/3. On Strong, also Slide it 1 square to a visible supported square, applying Stability. Each upkeep renews the original Slowed rating without another Slide. A conscious target may spend a Main Action to escape using the printed attributes. Escape or ending Sustain removes this casting’s Slowed.

Levitate — Objects

ID: spell:telekinesis:5 Page: 5 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended object of Bulk 3 or less within 6 squares Duration: Sustained, up to 1 minute

Lift it up to 3 squares from its supporting surface. Each upkeep moves it up to 2 squares through open space. Place it gently when the spell ends. It can carry its ordinary contents, but living riders require their own movement or support.

Shatter

ID: spell:telekinesis:6 Page: 6 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: Every creature and unattended fragile object in a 1-square-radius burst within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Sound a sharp resonant crack. Deal 3/5/7 force damage. Ordinary unattended glass or brittle pottery in the burst shatters; sturdier structures use their HP or a DA-set demolition objective.

Telekinesis

ID: spell:telekinesis:7 Page: 7 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: Class Defense: Brawn Target / range: One creature or unattended object within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Move a creature 1/2/3 squares toward a visible supported destination, applying Stability. Alternatively, automatically move an unattended object of Bulk 6 or less up to 3 squares. The route must be open and wide enough for the target.

Resilient Sphere

ID: spell:telekinesis:8 Page: 8 Action: Main Action SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Enclose it in a translucent sphere with 12 HP and resistance 2 to all damage. Attacks from outside strike the sphere; the recipient may roll it 1 square using its movement. Actions affecting the outside require leaving with a Maneuver. Destruction ends the sphere after that damage event.

Wall of Force

ID: spell:telekinesis:a1 Page: A1 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: Six connected unoccupied squares within 12 squares Duration: 1 minute

Raise a transparent force wall 2 squares high. It blocks physical passage and attacks across it. All sections share 18 HP and resistance 2 to all damage; attacks always deal at least 1. Destroying the wall opens all its squares.

Disintegrate

ID: spell:telekinesis:a2 Page: A2 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: One creature or unattended object within 12 squares Duration: Instant

A narrow beam deals 6/9/12 force damage. An unattended nonmagical object of Bulk 3 or less is reduced to dust if this damage destroys it. Living targets follow normal HP and dying rules.

Reverse Gravity

ID: spell:telekinesis:a3 Page: A3 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: Every creature in a 2-square-radius area within 12 squares Duration: Until the end of your next turn

Lift each affected creature 2/4/6 squares vertically from its starting position, stopping at solid obstacles. It floats there until expiry, then falls from that height using the normal falling rules. A creature already holding a fixed support may keep its grip and remain supported. A floating creature may use ordinary movement to climb a reachable fixed surface or fly out of the affected area; leaving the area ends its levitation. This working affects the chosen creatures once, when cast.

text.content:
Discipline: Elements List: Earth ID: earth Endpoint: Deep Foundations

Soil, stone, excavation and reinforcement.

PageSpellSPSection
1Enchanted Rope0I
2Loosen Earth1I

6Stone Shape3III
7Stoneskin3IV
8Wall of Stone4IV
A1Move Earth5V
A2Flesh to Stone5VI

Spells

Enchanted Rope

ID: spell:earth:1 Page: 1 Action: Maneuver SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended rope up to 6 squares long within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Guide the rope's free end through a reachable opening and tie or undo one ordinary knot. It can secure itself to a suitable anchor. It bears its ordinary load and moves through unoccupied space.

Loosen Earth

ID: spell:earth:2 Page: 2 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One unoccupied square of loose earth within 6 squares, up to 1 square deep Duration: Instant

Loosen, shift or pile the soil into an adjacent unoccupied square. Work around buried structures and roots. The resulting earth is ordinary material.

Earthwall

ID: spell:earth:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Three connected unoccupied ground squares within 6 squares Duration: 10 minutes

Raise a bank of packed earth 1 square high. It provides cover and costs 2 movement to climb. Each bank square has 6 HP and physical resistance 1.

Cracks Call

ID: spell:earth:4 Page: 4 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One visible unoccupied 2-square section of stone within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Split ordinary stone along an existing weakness. Add 2/4/6 progress toward a DA-set demolition objective declared before casting. Creatures supported by collapsing stone may use their normal falling responses. Magical barriers use their own removal procedures.

Meld into Stone

ID: spell:earth:5 Page: 5 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: Self; one adjacent natural stone mass large enough to hold you Duration: 10 minutes

Step inside the stone with your carried gear. You can hear muffled sounds and may emerge from your entry face with a Maneuver. While inside, rest and observe; manipulating the outside world requires emerging. If the stone is broken apart, emerge into the nearest open square and take 3 physical damage.

Stone Shape

ID: spell:earth:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent unattended stone mass, up to one square in each dimension Duration: Instant

Reshape existing stone into a doorway, trough, steps or similarly simple form. Preserve its volume and structural support. Fine mechanisms require ordinary finishing work.

Stoneskin

ID: spell:earth:7 Page: 7 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Harden the recipient's skin like weathered granite. It gains physical resistance 2, using the highest matching resistance.

Wall of Stone

ID: spell:earth:8 Page: 8 Action: Main Action SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: Six connected unoccupied squares on solid ground within 12 squares Duration: 1 hour

Raise a stone wall 2 squares high. Each section has 12 HP and physical resistance 2. It can include openings you shape when casting. At expiry the conjured stone crumbles into harmless dust.

Move Earth

ID: spell:earth:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: A 10-by-10-square patch of soil within 12 squares Duration: Instant

Grade, trench or mound earth by up to 2 squares of depth or height. Shift it within the chosen patch, preserving volume. Move exposed loose soil around foundations rather than carrying buildings or creatures with it.

Flesh to Stone

ID: spell:earth:a2 Page: A2 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Fortitude Target / range: One creature within 6 squares Duration: Until the end of your next turn; conditions then decay normally

Stone creeps across the target. Apply Slowed 2/3/4. On Standard or Strong, also apply Paralyzed 1. If the target is still Slowed by your previous casting, Standard or Strong also makes it Petrified for 1 minute. Remove Curse, Greater Restoration or the caster's Maneuver ends that petrification.

Earthquake

ID: spell:earth:a3 Page: A3 Action: Main Action SP: 6 Attribute: Class Defense: Agility Target / range: Every grounded creature in a 3-square-radius area within 12 squares Duration: Instant

Shake the ground violently. Deal 5/8/11 physical damage and make affected creatures Prone. Add 3/5/7 progress toward one visible structure's DA-set collapse objective in the area; the DA describes unstable features before the roll. Each creature takes the spell's damage once; collapsing structures use their normal hazard rules.

Discipline: Divination List: Detection ID: detection Endpoint: The Unhidden

Nearby presences, properties and traces.

PageSpellSPSection
1Detect Magic0I
2Detect Poison and Disease1I

6Identify3III

Spells

Detect Magic

ID: spell:detection:1 Page: 1 Action: Maneuver SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: One visible object or creature within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Sense whether an active magical effect is present on the target. Learn whether the strongest visible aura is protective, transformative, harmful or informative. To investigate a concealed source, first expose it or use a spell that can examine it through the concealment.

Detect Poison and Disease

ID: spell:detection:2 Page: 2 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Food, drink or one willing creature within 1 square Duration: Instant

Determine whether ordinary poison or disease is present and identify its broad type: ingested, inhaled, contact or bodily infection. The reading helps select suitable treatment.

Detect Evil and Good

ID: spell:detection:3 Page: 3 Action: Main Action SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: Visible creatures or objects within 6 squares Duration: Until your next turn ends

Perceive the presence of summoned forms, undead and active spirit bindings. Learn which visible targets bear those properties. Their motives are discovered through interaction.

Find Traps

ID: spell:detection:4 Page: 4 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One visible 3-by-3-square area within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Sense intentionally prepared mechanisms or magical triggers that could harm an entrant. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a search objective set by the DA. At completion identify each detected trigger's location and how it is activated; disarming uses its own procedure.

See Invisibility

ID: spell:detection:5 Page: 5 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: 1 minute

See Invisible creatures and objects within 6 squares as translucent outlines. This satisfies visual targeting at that distance; solid cover still blocks sight.

Identify

ID: spell:detection:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent object examined throughout the ritual Duration: Instant

Learn 1/2/3 facts about its active magical properties, chosen from activation, charges or costs, duration, and an explicit drawback. The DA gives accurate facts available from the item's current enchantment.

True Seeing

ID: spell:detection:7 Page: 7 Action: Main Action SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: 1 minute

Within 6 squares, see Invisible targets and perceive the original outline beneath visual illusions or disguising magic. You recognize illusion as illusion while retaining sight of the underlying scene. Solid barriers retain their normal visibility limits.

Analysis

ID: spell:detection:8 Page: 8 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 4 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent object, creature or fixed magical effect Duration: Instant

Add 2/4/6 progress toward understanding one magical effect, with target 6. Each completed analysis reveals its purpose, remaining duration, whether it requires Sustain and one named remedy or interruption method. Use further castings for further effects.

Detect Magic — Scaling Analysis

ID: spell:detection:a1 Page: A1 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Target / range: Up to three visible magical sources within 6 squares Duration: Instant

Read their relative strength. Learn each source's spell name if known, its SP cost or equivalent strength, and its remaining duration on Standard or Strong; Weak reveals only the strongest source and whether it is sustained. Choose all targets before rolling.

Find the Path

ID: spell:detection:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: Self; a known fixed destination within 1 kilometer Duration: 1 hour

Sense the direction of an ordinary traversable route to a location you previously visited. At each junction, learn which way continues along that route. Terrain and locks still require ordinary travel and interaction; if no traversable route exists, the reading identifies the nearest obstruction.

Sight True

ID: spell:detection:a3 Page: A3 Action: Main Action SP: 6 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: 1 hour

See Invisible targets and recognize visual illusions and disguising magic within 12 squares. Also see the outlines of creatures and magical effects immediately beyond ordinary cover up to 1 square thick, within 6 squares. The outlines reveal position; attacks still require a clear path. Explicit wards against divination retain their protection.

Discipline: Divination List: Echoes ID: echoes Endpoint: Witness of Ages

Read traces left by past events.

Spells

Origins

ID: spell:echoes:1 Page: 1 Action: Maneuver SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: One unattended object held in your hands Duration: Instant

Sense its principal ordinary material and whether it was grown, shaped, mined or assembled. This gives a useful starting point for further investigation.

Past Visions

ID: spell:echoes:2 Page: 2 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent fixed place or unattended object Duration: Instant

Receive 1/2/3 sensory impressions of its most recent notable event within the past day. The DA presents concrete sights, sounds or touches from that event.

Power Lore

ID: spell:echoes:3 Page: 3 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 1 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent magical object Duration: Instant

Learn 1/2/3 historical facts about how its enchantment was made or previously used. Facts concern its actual history, not current activation instructions unless the remembered event demonstrates them.

Item Vision

ID: spell:echoes:4 Page: 4 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One object held throughout the ritual Duration: Instant

See a brief scene involving its most recent owner within the last month. Weak reveals the owner's appearance, Standard also the scene's surroundings, and Strong also one spoken exchange of up to twenty words.

Vision Guide

ID: spell:echoes:5 Page: 5 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent site Duration: Instant

Ask how one visible trace came to be here. Add 1/2/3 progress toward a historical inquiry objective, target 3. At completion see the event that left that trace, if it occurred within the last year.

Delving

ID: spell:echoes:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 3 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent object or ruin Duration: Instant

Add 2/4/6 progress toward uncovering one named part of its history, target 6. At completion learn who made it, its intended purpose, and one subsequent event relevant to your question, reaching back up to a century.

Vision Location

ID: spell:echoes:7 Page: 7 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One object held; its former location within 10 kilometers Duration: Instant

See the surroundings where the object spent the longest uninterrupted time during the last month. Learn the direction and approximate distance from your present location if that place lies within range.

Past Store

ID: spell:echoes:8 Page: 8 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: One held crystal or polished stone Duration: Until replayed or 7 days pass

Store up to one minute of what you personally see and hear during the ritual. A later Main Action holding the stone plays the memory as a small shared image and sound. The stone holds one recording; you may keep three prepared stones.

Legend Lore

ID: spell:echoes:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent historic object or site; 25 coins of incense consumed Duration: Instant

Ask one question about an important event in its history. Weak reveals one truthful clue, Standard a brief accurate account, and Strong the account plus a practical lead to evidence or another witness. The DA draws from the object's real past.

Past Truth

ID: spell:echoes:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One adjacent site and one specific event within the past year Duration: Instant

View up to ten minutes of that event from a fixed point at the site. The vision shows what happened there, including audible speech. Magical concealment that obscured the event remains part of the vision.

Vision Behind — Ages

ID: spell:echoes:a3 Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 8 hours SP: 5 Attribute: Class Target / range: One adjacent ancient site; 100 coins of rare incense consumed Duration: Instant

Explore one named event up to a thousand years old. Add 3/5/7 progress toward target 7. At completion witness up to one hour from a fixed position and learn one surviving location or object connected to it. Each further attempt requires a new ritual and its costs.

Discipline: Divination List: Farseeing ID: farseeing Endpoint: Beyond the Horizon

Observe beyond ordinary reach through defined connections.

Spells

Nightsight

ID: spell:farseeing:1 Page: 1 Action: Maneuver SP: 0 Attribute: None Target / range: Self Duration: 10 minutes

See clearly in dim light within 6 squares. In complete darkness, perceive only shapes already illuminated by a light source.

Clairvoyance

ID: spell:farseeing:2 Page: 2 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One visible point within 12 squares Duration: 1 minute

Place an invisible stationary sensor. Choose sight or hearing when casting; spend a Main Action to use that sense from the sensor until your next turn starts. Your own corresponding sense is occupied during that interval.

Locate Object

ID: spell:farseeing:3 Page: 3 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One familiar object within 100 squares Duration: 10 minutes

Sense its direction while holding an item of the same material. Choose a specific object you have handled or the nearest example of a common kind. Magical concealment expressly blocking divination stops the signal.

Locate Creature

ID: spell:farseeing:4 Page: 4 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One creature within 100 squares that you know or whose personal possession you hold Duration: 10 minutes

Sense its direction and whether it is moving closer or farther away. Name the creature you know or focus on an item it has used as a personal possession. The reading follows its current body.

Arcane Eye

ID: spell:farseeing:5 Page: 5 Action: Main Action SP: 2 Attribute: None Target / range: One sensor initially within 3 squares; remains within 12 squares Duration: 1 minute

Create a tiny visible glimmering eye. A Maneuver moves it up to 4 squares through open passages; otherwise it stays in place. Spend a Main Action to see from it until your next turn begins. The sensor has 1 HP and uses your Agility for player-rolled defenses.

Scrying

ID: spell:farseeing:6 Page: 6 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: Class Target / range: One consenting creature you personally know on the same plane Duration: 1 minute

Receive an image and sound of the space within 3 squares of the subject. Weak gives one brief glimpse, Standard up to thirty seconds, Strong the full minute. The subject senses your presence and may end the connection.

Long Ear

ID: spell:farseeing:7 Page: 7 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 3 Attribute: None Target / range: One point you have visited within 1 kilometer Duration: 10 minutes

Place a stationary listening sensor. Spend a Main Action to listen from it until your next turn begins. It hears ordinary sounds within 6 squares of that point, subject to intervening barriers and noise.

Watch II

ID: spell:farseeing:8 Page: 8 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 4 Attribute: None Target / range: Two fixed points within 12 squares Duration: 1 hour

Mark two observation points. While within 12 squares of either, you may spend a Main Action to see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Switching points takes another Main Action. Each viewpoint follows normal line of sight and hearing.

Watch True

ID: spell:farseeing:a1 Page: A1 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: Up to four fixed points you have visited within 1 kilometer Duration: 8 hours

Prepare a network of stationary observation points. A Main Action lets you see and hear from one until your next turn begins. Choose a different point with another Main Action. Magical concealment and ordinary barriers operate at each viewpoint.

Long Sense

ID: spell:farseeing:a2 Page: A2 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One point you have visited within 10 kilometers Duration: 10 minutes

Send sight and hearing to that fixed location. Spend a Main Action each round to observe until your next turn begins. While observing, your own sight and hearing rest at the remote point; touch can still alert you to nearby contact.

Long Sense True

ID: spell:farseeing:a3 Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 1 hour SP: 6 Attribute: None Target / range: Self and up to three willing creatures you personally know on the same plane Duration: 8 hours

Establish a remote sensory link with each recipient. A linked creature may spend a Main Action to see and hear from one consenting member until its next turn begins, while that member continues using its own senses. During that interval the observer’s own sight and hearing rest at the remote point; touch can still alert it to nearby contact. A member can leave the link at any time. Magical concealment operates at each viewpoint. Keep one Long Sense True link active; casting another ends the first.

Bounded warnings and possible consequences.

A1Foresight5V
A2Anticipations True5VI

Spells

True Strike

ID: spell:portents:1 Page: 1 Action: Main Action SP: 0 Attribute: Class Defense: Brawn against a melee weapon; Agility against a ranged weapon Target / range: One adjacent creature with a melee weapon, or one visible creature within 12 squares with a ranged weapon Duration: Instant

Follow a brief vision of the opening to come. Make one weapon attack using Reason and deal 2/3/5 physical damage. Use the weapon's ordinary hand and ammunition requirements.

Guidance

ID: spell:portents:2 Page: 2 Action: Maneuver SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing creature within 6 squares Duration: Until its next roll or your next turn ends

Offer a useful flash of intuition. Give 1 Boon to the recipient's next non-attack task roll. A creature can hold one Guidance benefit at a time.

Augury

ID: spell:portents:3 Page: 3 Action: Ritual · 1 minute SP: 1 Attribute: None Target / range: One course of action you intend to begin within 10 minutes Duration: Instant

Ask whether the contemplated course is likely to bring benefit, danger, both or neither during the next hour. The DA answers from current circumstances. New decisions can change the outcome. Ask once per distinct proposed course between overnight rests.

Escape or ending Sustain removes this casting’s conditions from the target.

Dominate Monster

ID: spell:binding:a1 Page: A1 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Reason Target / range: One creature within 6 squares that perceives your command Duration: Until the end of its next turn

Command one ordinary movement or interaction within the creature's abilities. It may obey using its own actions or take 4/6/8 mental damage and Dazed 1/1/2. Its player chooses for a hero. The command ends after that choice resolves.

Forcecage

ID: spell:binding:a2 Page: A2 Action: Main Action SP: 5 Attribute: Class Defense: Reason Target / range: An unoccupied 2-by-2-square cage boundary within 6 squares Duration: 1 minute

Form a cage around creatures fitting inside its boundary. Your casting roll gives it 10/15/20 HP. When an NPC casts around heroes, each enclosed hero rolls Reason instead. Use the strongest defense to give the shared cage 20/15/10 HP on Weak/Standard/Strong. The bars block bodily passage but allow sight and ranged targeting. The cage has resistance 2 to all damage and takes at least 1 per attack. Teleportation or destroying it permits escape. The caster may end it with a Maneuver.

Imprisonment

ID: spell:binding:a3 Page: A3 Action: Ritual · 10 minutes SP: 5 Attribute: None Target / range: One willing or continuously restrained adjacent creature; a 100-coin crystal consumed Duration: Until released or the crystal is broken

Enclose the creature in a palm-sized crystal where it sleeps and its needs pause. The crystal has 10 HP and physical resistance 1. Breaking it, Remove Curse, or your Main Action holding it releases the creature into the nearest open square with its prior HP and resources. Keep one such prison at a time.

A drawn blade changes the conversation. A broken bridge changes the journey. The rules help you decide what those changes mean when timing, danger and the choices of several characters meet.

Begin with what your hero is doing. You can use a learned ability, take a universal action, or describe something the situation makes possible. The DA establishes the circumstances and calls for a roll only when uncertainty has consequences.

When you use an ability, declare it before rolling. Read its requirements, choose its targets and any printed options, and check range and equipment. Spend the action and any required cost. Roll its attribute if instructed, then apply the complete Weak, Standard or Strong outcome. Finally, record conditions and continuing effects.
